record.question: Which hospital conducted the training course of Medical Record Technician in the year 1973?
record.explanation: Answer C: Safdarjung Hospital. The CBHI medical-record department training-centre history identifies Safdarjung Hospital as conducting the Medical Record Technician course beginning in 1973. Reference: https://cbhidghs.mohfw.gov.in/medical-record-department-training-centre-safdarjung-hospital-new-delhi. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
